beats.care: Hostel or college gang heading the same way? Get 30+ people together and ask TGSRTC for a bus from your gate.
beats.what: For Dasara, TGSRTC will run special buses that start right from residential colonies, gated communities, hostels and colleges.
beats.why: Festival travel jams up bus stations. Picking up groups near home makes the trip easier.

cards.body: Groups of 30 or more can contact the concerned TGSRTC officials and request a bus from their locality. Buses run when there's enough demand from an area.
It's demand-based: if enough people in one area ask, TGSRTC arranges a special service just for them.

cards.q: How big must your group be to request a TGSRTC pickup?
cards.why: The pickup service is for groups of 30 or more travelling together.

hook: Going home for Dasara? TGSRTC can *pick you up at your hostel*

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: TGSRTC to pick up Dasara travellers from residential colonies, hostels
